APPSC frequently asks World Food Prize and other award current affairs alongside scientist questions.
App's multi-statement items (Kalam, Swaminathan, Nayudamma) are deeper than PYQs but factually sound; AP scientists (SubbaRow, Nayudamma) are an AP-tilt gap in PYQs.
